name: Discerning skeptic (adversarial)

sources: Zoho CRM Consumers sample, 712 unique records, 516 genuine couples, analysed 2026-10-28
evidence.supporting_records: Models the leakage seen in the CRM: price checkers, proposals with no response, 'comparing several wedding services and plans to decide this week'

context: Has three other tabs open with competing planners and marketplaces. Looking for reasons to say no.
jobs_to_be_done: Find what is vague, unproven, overpriced or inconsistent
top_questions: What is NOT included in the from price?
Are these facts consistent across the page?
What proof is there that this team has done this venue before?
Why book through you and not the venue directly?
What happens if something goes wrong on the day?

objections.objection: From price with no inclusions list means hidden costs
Inconsistent numbers (capacity or rooms differ in two places)
objections.source: Fact conflicts found during page builds

trust_signals_that_work: A clear reason to use the concierge
turn_offs: Anything that looks copied from another listing
verbatims: comparing several wedding services and plans to decide this week
reading_behaviour: Reads everything, checks numbers against each other, looks for the catch
conversion_threshold: Will enquire only if no inconsistency or unanswered cost question remains
